rawCream.text: The fat is lighter than the rest of the milk. Left to stand it floats up as a layer; in a dairy a centrifugal separator does the same in seconds and sends cream and skimmed milk out of separate outlets. In the hermetic type the bowl stays full of milk and cream leaves from the centre.

skimRaw.text: The skim milk is what is left of raw milk when the cream has been spun off: it is the other half of the same separating step and still raw until it is heat-treated.
